config.script:
# Writes the operator's downtime reason onto the most recent
	# downtime_debarker row.
	#
	# Each group below is a stack of dropdowns whose meta.visible is driven by an
	# expression binding, so only one member of a group is ever on screen. Reading
	# the visible one by name keeps this script in step with those bindings, and
	# leaves an unselected group as an ordinary validation message rather than an
	# unbound local that aborts the click and silently loses the entry.
	form = self.parent.parent.parent

	SUB_AREAS = [
		"infeed_subarea", "debarker_subarea", "logscanning_subarea", "outfeed_subarea",
		"logsorting_subarea", "wastehandling_subarea"
	]
	EQUIPMENT = [
		"PRODUCTION_EQUIPMENT", "MECHANICAL_EQUIPMENT", "ELECTRICAL_EQUIPMENT", "EMERGENCY_EQUIPMENT"
	]
	ACTIONS = [
		"PRODUCTION_SETUP", "PRODUCTION_STAFF", "PRODUCTION_FEEDSTOCK", "PRODUCTION_BLOCKAGE",
		"PRODUCTION_HOUSEKEEPING", "PRODUCTION_CONSUMABLES", "PRODUCTION_LOGLOADER", "MECHANICAL_PNEUCYL",
		"MECHANICAL_PIPE", "MECHANICAL_VALVE", "MECHANICAL_HYDRAUCYL", "MECHANICAL_HYDRAUPIPE",
		"MECHANICAL_HYDRAUVALVE", "MECHANICAL_MOTOR", "MECHANICAL_BEARING", "MECHANICAL_CONVEYOR",
		"MECHANICAL_CHAIN", "MECHANICAL_WEARSTRIP", "MECHANICAL_SPROCKET", "MECHANICAL_BELT",
		"MECHANICAL_PULLEY", "MECHANICAL_V-BELT", "MECHANICAL_PLATEN", "MECHANICAL_STEAMTRAP",
		"MECHANICAL_SHAFT", "MECHANICAL_PUMP", "ELECTRICAL_MOTOR", "ELECTRICAL_CABLE",
		"ELECTRICAL_BREAKER", "ELECTRICAL_MCC", "ELECTRICAL_PHOTOCELL", "ELECTRICAL_LIMITSWITCH",
		"ELECTRICAL_TRANSDUCER", "ELECTRICAL_SOFTSTARTER", "ELECTRICAL_VSD", "ELECTRICAL_OVERLOAD",
		"ELECTRICAL_LIGHTCURTAIN", "ELECTRICAL_CAMERA", "ELECTRICAL_SOLENOIDVALVE", "ELECTRICAL_PLUG",
		"ELECTRICAL_COIL", "ELECTRICAL_LIGHT", "ELECTRICAL_HEATER", "ELECTRICAL_COOLER",
		"ELECTRICAL_ENCODER", "ELECTRICAL_PLC.PROGRAM", "ELECTRICAL_PUMP", "EMERGENCYSERVICES",
		"PRODUCTION_BINFULL"
	]

	def child(container, name):
		try:
			return container.getChild(name)
		except Exception:
			return None

	def selected(container, names):
		"""Value of the one visible dropdown in the group, or None if none is."""
		for name in names:
			dropdown = child(container, name)
			if dropdown is not None and dropdown.meta.visible:
				return dropdown.props.value
		return None

	def clear(container, names):
		for name in names:
			dropdown = child(container, name)
			if dropdown is not None:
				dropdown.props.value = None

	areaDropdown = form.getChild("FlexContainer").getChild("Dropdown")
	responDropdown = form.getChild("FlexContainer_2").getChild("Dropdown")
	subAreaGroup = form.getChild("FlexContainer_1").getChild("CoordinateContainer")
	equipmentGroup = form.getChild("EQUIPMENT").getChild("CoordinateContainer")
	actionGroup = form.getChild("FlexContainer_0").getChild("CoordinateContainer")
	commentBox = form.getChild("FlexContainer_7").getChild("TextArea")

	entry = [
		("AREA", areaDropdown.props.value),
		("SUB AREA", selected(subAreaGroup, SUB_AREAS)),
		("RESPONSIBILITY", responDropdown.props.value),
		("EQUIPMENT", selected(equipmentGroup, EQUIPMENT)),
		("ACTION", selected(actionGroup, ACTIONS)),
	]

	missing = [label for label, value in entry if value is None or not str(value).strip()]
	if missing:
		self.view.custom.formMessage = "Still to select: " + ", ".join(missing)
		return

	columns = ["area", "sub_area", "responsibility", "equipment", "action"]
	values = [value for label, value in entry]

	comments = commentBox.props.text
	if comments and comments.strip():
		columns.append("comments")
		values.append(comments)

	logger = system.util.getLogger("Debarker.Downtime")
	commentDropped = False

	def save(columns, args):
		return system.db.runPrepUpdate(
				"UPDATE downtime_debarker SET "
				+ ", ".join([column + " = ?" for column in columns])
				+ " WHERE start_time = ?",
				args, "downtime_data")

	try:
		# Pin the row rather than subquerying downtime_debarker inside its own
		# UPDATE: MySQL rejects that outright (error 1093), and reading the value
		# back lets us tell the operator when there is nothing to annotate.
		latest = system.db.runPrepQuery(
				"SELECT max(start_time) FROM downtime_debarker", [], "downtime_data")
		start_time = latest[0][0] if len(latest) else None

		if start_time is None:
			self.view.custom.formMessage = "No downtime entry to update."
			return

		try:
			updated = save(columns, values + [start_time])
		except Exception as writeError:
			if "comments" not in columns:
				raise
			# The reason matters more than the note, so if the table has no
			# comments column, store everything else and say what was dropped.
			logger.warn("Retrying without comments after: %s" % writeError)
			commentDropped = True
			columns.remove("comments")
			updated = save(columns, values[:-1] + [start_time])
	except Exception as error:
		logger.error("Downtime entry failed: %s" % error)
		self.view.custom.formMessage = "Could not save - see the gateway logs."
		return

	if not updated:
		self.view.custom.formMessage = "No downtime entry to update."
		return

	areaDropdown.props.value = None
	responDropdown.props.value = None
	clear(subAreaGroup, SUB_AREAS)
	clear(equipmentGroup, EQUIPMENT)
	clear(actionGroup, ACTIONS)
	commentBox.props.text = ""

	if commentDropped:
		# Leave the popup open so the message is actually read.
		self.view.custom.formMessage = (
				"Reason saved. Comment not stored - downtime_debarker has no comments column.")
		return

	self.view.custom.formMessage = ""
	system.perspective.closePopup("97oSJOmz")
